questions.stem: A rectangle is inscribed in a circle, such that each vertex of the rectangle lies on the circumference of the circle. The diagonal of the rectangle is twice the length of the shortest side of the rectangle. The area of the rectangle is 1,089√3 square units. What is the length, in units, of the diameter of the circle?

ledger.recompute: 短边a，对角线2a，长边=√(4a²−a²)=a√3；面积a²√3=1,089√3→a²=1089→a=33；直径=对角线=2a=66
